capabilities: Show the active file's creation date in the status bar
Show the active file's last updated date in the status bar
Display dates for notes, images, and PDFs
extras: Desktop-only; on some Linux file systems the creation date may be missing because the file system does not store it.
problem: Obsidian's status bar does not show when the currently open file was created or last modified, so you must check file metadata elsewhere.
summary: Status bar plugin that shows the creation date and last updated date of the active file.
